newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish authority says may okay NCC, Siab merger.
newsitem.headline: Swedish authority says may okay NCC, Siab merger.

text.p: The Swedish Competition Authority said on Tuesday it would approve Swedish construction company NCC's bid for rival Siab provided certain conditions were met.
"NCC has made a number of structural undertakings to get approval for its acquisition of Siab," the authority said in a statement.
"With these undertakings the Competition Authority estimates that the negative effects of the acquisition have been removed," it said.

NCC has, among other things, undertaken to sell Siab's shares in concrete and ballast producer Swerock AB and to dissolve seven joint ventures with construction group Skanska within the asphalt and ballast area.

The acquisition means that two of the four largest players on the Swedish construction market will merge, creating a construction group with about 23,000 employees and a total annual turnover of 33 billion crowns, the authority said.
